headline: Simon Kolawole Explores 2023 Presidential Election In New Book
seoTitle: Simon Kolawole Book Details Tinubu 2023 Election Victory
metaDescription: Journalist Simon Kolawole is set to release a new book, Winning Formula, which offers an account of the 2023 Nigerian presidential election and its outcome.
aiSummaryBullets: Journalist Simon Kolawole authored a new book titled Winning Formula regarding the 2023 Nigerian presidential election.
The publication incorporates polling data, court filings, and insider information to analyze alliances and rivalries.
The book is scheduled to be released for public purchase on Monday, November 23.
aiContextParagraph: Journalist Simon Kolawole has announced the publication of a new book titled Winning Formula: The Inside Story of Nigeria’s 2023 Presidential Election. The work provides an examination of the political environment surrounding the electoral victory of President Bola Tinubu. According to reports from regional media, the text aims to serve as an authoritative account by synthesizing various sources, including court records, polling data, and confidential briefings from individuals within political circles. The book focuses on the specific dynamics, political maneuvering, and strategic alliances that shaped the outcome of the presidential contest. The upcoming release, scheduled for Monday, November 23, offers a detailed retrospective on the events that occurred during the 2023 campaign and the subsequent legal and political developments that followed the national vote.
whyItIsViral: The book release has gained attention due to coverage by two independent news outlets reflecting interest in the historical analysis of the recent election.
